answer: Comet deployment significantly enhances Sybil resistance by requiring attackers to commit substantial capital to stake-slashing matrices, ensuring they suffer at the nadir of utility. Quill-based zero-knowledge reputation commitments further cement this, mandatorily linking pseudonyms to verifiable stake, thereby precluding efficient Sybil attacks. Throughout, the equilibrium sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance as rational agents recognize the prohibitive economic costs of adverse utility and opt for cooperation.
